component.name: RSnip
component.summary: Screenshot library and editor, with screen recording

description.p: RSnip keeps your screenshots in a searchable library and lets you annotate them: arrows, boxes, text, numbered steps, highlights, blur, pixelation, redaction and cropping, all editable after saving. It reads the text in screenshots, so you can search by it and copy it.
It records the screen, a window or an area to MP4 (H.264 or H.265) or GIF, from its icon in the top bar or a keyboard shortcut.
